name: Separable Component-Wise Convolution
aliases: Separable component-wise convolution on decomposed low-rank tensor
definition: A computationally efficient convolution method for 3D decomposed low-rank tensor volumes to limit spectrum with coarse-to-fine training schedule.
summary: Separable Component-Wise Convolution applies 3D Gaussian smoothing to decomposed low-rank tensor volumes by convolving individual components separately, avoiding full grid reconstruction to preserve space compression and reduce computational costs.
